common.translationNotice: This is a reference translation. The Korean text is the original.

login.title: Sign in
login.button: Sign in with fingerprint or face
login.heroTitle:
From clock-in to clock-out,
in a single tap
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Contact your manager.

register.title: Create your password
register.explain: Choose a password for signing in. From now on you sign in with your employee number and this password, on any PC or phone. To clock in and out, you register one phone of your own after signing in.
register.codeHelp: Ask your manager for an 8-character code. Capital letters and spaces do not matter.
register.haveAccount: Already have a password? Sign in
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. It cannot be the same as your employee number.

home.noRule: Work hours are not set yet.
home.already: Already recorded. You do not need to tap again.
home.outsideOffice: Recorded. It looks like you were not on the office network.

week.title: This week
week.noRule: Weekly hours appear after work hours are set.
week.addOnOut: Today's time is added when you clock out

note.title: Work note
note.hint: Work details only. Please do not write health or personal matters.
note.placeholder: e.g. Visited a client, came back at 3 pm

home.outsideNoLocation: Recorded. You are not on the office internet and your location could not be checked. Allow location access to be checked by location next time.

device.registerExplain: You can clock in and out only from one registered device. Register the phone you carry every day. Each time you punch, the device checks your fingerprint or face (or screen lock).
device.registered: This device is registered. Use the button below to punch.
device.privacy: Your fingerprint or face never leaves the device. The company only stores a security key that cannot be turned back into your fingerprint.
device.otherTitle: You cannot punch from this device
device.otherExplain: You can punch only from your registered device. If you changed phones, ask your manager to release the punch device.
device.otherExplainLabel: You can punch only from your registered device ({label}). If you changed phones, ask your manager to release the punch device.
device.otherRetry: This is my registered device · check again
device.pcTitle: You cannot punch from a PC
device.pcExplain: You clock in and out from one phone of your own. Sign in on your phone and a register button appears here. On a PC you can view records and send requests.

home.cancelled: The check was cancelled, or this is not your registered punch device.
home.passkey_unknown: This device is not registered as a punch device.
home.passkey_revoked: This device was released. Please register it again.
home.unsupported: This browser cannot do the device check. Please open the app in Chrome or Safari.
home.requestedExplain: You are outside the work place radius. Nothing is recorded yet; once a manager approves, it is recorded at this time.
home.requestedNoLocation: Your location could not be confirmed. Nothing is recorded yet; once a manager approves, it is recorded at this time. Allow location access to be recorded right away inside the radius.

settings.title: Home settings
settings.hint: Only the cards you turn on appear on Home. The Today card (clock in/out) cannot be turned off. This setting is saved on this device only.

errors.invite_invalid: This invitation link has expired or was already used. Ask your manager for a new one.
errors.employee_inactive: This account is not active. Please talk to your manager.
errors.phone_only: A punch device can only be registered on a phone. Please sign in on your own phone to register.
errors.already_registered: You already have a registered punch device. To change it, a manager must release the current one first.
errors.challenge_invalid: The request took too long. Please try again.
errors.verification_failed: The device check failed. Please try again.
errors.user_verification_missing: Please set up a screen lock (fingerprint, PIN or pattern) on your phone first, then try again.
errors.passkey_unknown: Fingerprint/face sign-in is not set up on this device. Sign in with your employee number and password.
errors.passkey_revoked: Fingerprint/face sign-in on this device was turned off. Sign in with your employee number and password.
errors.cancelled: The device check was cancelled. Please try again.
errors.login_cancelled: The check was cancelled, or fingerprint/face sign-in is not set up on this device. Sign in with your employee number and password.
errors.unsupported: This browser cannot use fingerprint/face sign-in. Sign in with your employee number and password.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.wrong_person: This device is registered to another account.
errors.period_locked: This month is closed. Ask your manager.
errors.payroll_only: Only payroll staff can download this file.
errors.register_failed: This device could not create the registration. Check the items below and try again.
errors.notice_period: Check the period. The end must be after the start.
errors.notice_legal_review: Legal or pay notices need a reviewed English translation before publishing.
errors.notice_numbers_review: Numbers in the translation differ from the original. Fix them and mark as reviewed.
errors.self_decision: You cannot handle your own request. Ask another admin.
errors.login_failed: The employee number or password is not correct. Please check and try again.
errors.login_throttled: Too many wrong attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
errors.password_short: The password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.password_long: The password is too long. Please choose a shorter one.
errors.password_same_as_id: The password cannot be the same as your employee number.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.password_wrong: The current password is not correct.
errors.device_required: Please register your punch device first.
errors.day_confirmed: This day is confirmed. An admin must undo the confirmation before it can be changed.

members.title: Staff
members.empty: No staff yet. Add the first person below.
members.name: Name
members.employeeNoHelp: Letters, numbers and - only (up to 20). Used to sign in.
members.newInviteConfirm: Earlier unused links for {name} will stop working. Create a new link?
members.inviteHelp: Let {name} point the phone camera at this QR code to open the password screen.
members.localhostWarning: This address only works on this PC. Staff can sign up after the app is deployed (gate 9).
members.invalid_no: Employee number: letters, numbers and - only (up to 20).
members.invalid_name: Please enter a name (up to 50 characters).
members.step1: The person taps the link you sent.
members.step2: They choose a password for signing in (at least 8 characters).
members.step3: After signing in on their phone, they tap "Register this device for punching" on the home screen. Every day: open the app → Clock in → one fingerprint.
members.codeHelp: Or type {origin} in the browser → "Create my password" → enter this code.
members.qrInPerson: Signing up in person? Show a QR code
members.orgEmptyHint: No departments or teams yet. Create them in "Org chart" to group staff by department.
members.groupEmpty: No one in this department yet.
members.phoneHelp: Digits and - only. For contact; can also be used as the sign-in ID instead of the employee number.
members.groupNone: Create departments and teams in "Org chart" first to choose one here.
members.registered: {name} has been registered. Now send the invite link.
members.invalid_phone: Use digits and - only for the mobile number (7–20 characters).
members.invalid_group: That group was not found. Please refresh.
members.invalid_date: The start date must be today or earlier.
members.loginPasskeyOnly: No password (fingerprint sign-in on the punch device only)
members.loginInviteHint: Send the link and the employee creates a password and signs in right away.
members.loginResetHint: Forgotten password? Send the link again. Once they create a new password, the old one stops working.
members.deviceNoneHint: The employee signs in on their own phone and registers it from the home screen.
members.pcIntro: Manage departments, titles, access and sign-up status, and invite employees with a code.

more.title: All menus
more.diagHint: Check what internet address the server sees
more.noticesHint: Write pop-up notices for staff · who has read them
more.leaveHint: Enter annual leave · balances · cancel approved leave
more.settingsHint: Work hours · holidays · office internet address

diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.subtitle: Values the server actually saw for this request. Use this when the office check looks wrong.
diag.noRanges: No office range is registered yet. Every record is marked "outside office" until one is added (gate 5).
diag.notMeasured: Not measured yet — measure after deployment (gate 9).
diag.rateHint: A sudden jump usually means the office internet address changed. Add the new range — do not replace the old one.

home.title: Today
home.noRule: Work hours are not set, so late and working-late cannot be judged.
home.notesHint: Written by staff as they typed it (original text).
home.headline: {n} of {total} in today
home.basisToday: Today only. Counts reset at midnight.
home.basisLate: Late: clocked in after {time} (start time + grace)
home.basisAbsent: Not in: workday, but no clock-in yet
home.basisOne: Each person is counted once (out → overtime → late → working → not in). Someone late and still working late shows under overtime with a "late" note.
home.basisPast: Past days and monthly totals are in the Records tab.
home.cardLeaveNone: No employee has a leave grant yet.

inbox.title: Requests
inbox.practiceBanner: Practice records — decisions here do not affect real records.
inbox.overtimeHint: Counted hours are facts and cannot be changed. You decide how much to recognize. Rejecting does not delete the work record.
inbox.partialHint: Enter the minutes to recognize (up to the counted minutes).
inbox.confirmApprove: Recognize all overtime {o} min · night {n} min · holiday {h} min for {name}?
inbox.confirmPartial: Recognize overtime {o} min · night {n} min · holiday {h} min for {name}?
inbox.confirmReject: Do not recognize the overtime for {name}?
inbox.rejectKeepsRecord: The work record stays as it is. Only the recognition is refused.
inbox.confirmCorrection: Approve the correction for {name}? It will be used in the hours.
inbox.originalKept: The original record is never changed.
inbox.conflict: A missing record for the same day was already approved.
inbox.over_fact: Recognized minutes cannot exceed counted minutes.
inbox.leaveBalance: {remaining} days left · {pending} days waiting (incl. this one)
inbox.leaveNoGrant: Annual leave has not been entered for this person yet.
inbox.leaveClash: ⚠ There are clock-ins on: {dates}. Approving does not delete them — reject the leave or correct the records.
inbox.confirmLeaveCancel: Cancel approved leave for {name}? Those days count as workdays again.
inbox.workClashHint: Approving keeps the fact that clock-ins were outside the office; they are shown as "approved off-site".
inbox.selfBlocked: Another admin handles your own request.
inbox.recentHint: What admins approved, rejected or cancelled in the last {days} days.
inbox.confirmPunch: Approve the {summary} request from {name}? It will be recorded at that time.
inbox.confirmPunchReject: Reject the {summary} request from {name}? Nothing will be recorded.
inbox.punchFar: {m} m from the nearest work place
inbox.confirmShift: Approve {name}'s schedule request ({summary})? A schedule will be created for that date.
inbox.confirmLeaveDelete: Approve {name}'s leave deletion request ({summary})? The leave will be cancelled and the balance restored.
inbox.confirmLeaveDeleteReject: Reject {name}'s leave deletion request ({summary})? The leave stays as it is.
inbox.focusGone: This request has already been handled or cannot be found.
inbox.pcIntro: Review staff requests, approve or reject them, and check their status.
inbox.mapShared: The location on this map was shared with managers to review this request.
inbox.mapNone: This request has no location (no fix, or no location consent).

records.title: Records
records.noRule: Work hours are not set, so hours cannot be calculated.
records.empty: No staff to show for this month.
records.overtimeRow: Overtime: actual · approved · waiting · unreviewed (under 30 min)
records.name: Name
records.leaveNote: Approved leave days are not counted as absent. If someone clocked in on a leave day it is marked "clock-in on leave day".
records.privacyWarning: These files contain staff personal information. Do not put them in shared folders.
records.reportXlsxHint: Print-ready form with signature boxes + raw records, corrections and the rules used. Prints on one A4 page.
records.payrollCsvHint: For the payroll program. Do not open it in Excel to check — use the report above for people.

notices.title: Notices
notices.bodyHint: Line breaks OK · no formatting · https links become clickable
notices.modeReshow: Content change — show again to everyone (default)
notices.modeTypo: Typo fix — people who read it won't see it again
notices.translationsHint: Notices are translated automatically when published and shown in each person’s language. Use the button below only to preview or edit before publishing.
notices.translated: Draft ready. Read, fix and save.
notices.translateNoKey: Auto translation is not connected yet. Type English below, or publish in Korean only.
notices.translateFailed: Could not make a translation draft. Type English below, or publish in Korean only.
notices.confirmArchive: Archived notices disappear for staff. Read records stay.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.subtitle: Monthly hours summary · payroll file
payroll.noAccess: Only payroll managers can see this screen. Current payroll managers: {names}. A payroll manager can give this permission to another admin in the Role column of the staff list.
payroll.building: Payslips (base pay, allowances, insurance, tax) are being built. For now: hours summary and the payroll file.
payroll.unconfirmed: {n} day(s) of records are not confirmed. Only confirmed records are used for payroll, so those hours are not in the numbers below or the download.
payroll.confirmedOnly: Only confirmed records are counted. There are no unconfirmed records this month.

weekLimit.title: 52-hour weekly limit
weekLimit.empty: No one has passed 40 hours this week.
weekLimit.hint: Staff over 40 hours this week (Mon–Sun). Marked from 48 hours.
weekLimit.flagged: {n} need attention — adjust their remaining days.

leave.title: Leave
leave.intro: Enter a join date and the statutory annual leave is calculated and filled in. Check it and save to confirm (nothing is saved automatically).
leave.practiceBanner: Practice records — leave requests and approvals here are practice. Leave entitlements are real.
leave.manualHint: In 0.25-day steps. Saving again with the same period name updates it; changes are kept in the change log.
leave.approvedHint: Approved leave from the last 31 days on. Cancel here if it clashes with clock-ins.
leave.joinedOnHint: Enter the join date to calculate annual leave.
leave.prefilled: Filled with the calculated {n} days from the join date. Check and save.
leave.invalid_date: The join date must be today or earlier.
leave.pcHistoryIntro: Browse approved leave as a list or by month, and cancel leave entered by mistake.
leave.pcAccrualIntro: See each employee's granted, used and remaining days as of a date, and enter hire dates and grants.
leave.emptyYear: No approved leave in this year.

detail.practiceBanner: Practice records — anything you add here is also a practice record.
detail.addOther: Add a record on another date
detail.nextDay: This time is after midnight (next day)
detail.reasonHint: Required. Who added it, when and why are kept on record, and the employee can see it in their corrections.
detail.confirmWarn: Check the date and time again. If it is wrong, you can cancel it on this screen with a reason.
detail.otherHint: Use this for a date not listed above, such as work on a day off.
detail.footNote: Original punches are never changed. Records added by an admin are marked "Entered by admin" and also appear in the Excel report.
detail.reason_required: Enter a reason of at least 2 characters (up to 200).
detail.future_time: A future time cannot be added.
detail.already_exists: That record already exists on this date.
detail.pending_exists: The employee has a pending request for this. Handle it in the Requests tab.
detail.time_order: Clock-out must be after clock-in. Check the time.
detail.selfNote: You cannot add your own records here. Send a correction request and another admin will handle it.
detail.proxy_self: You cannot add your own record. Please send a correction request.
detail.cancelWarn: Once cancelled, this correction is left out of work-hour calculations. The cancellation stays on record and you can add it again if needed.
detail.self_change: You cannot cancel a correction on your own record. Ask another admin.
detail.already: It is already cancelled or not approved. Please refresh.

org.title: Org chart
org.intro: Two levels: departments and their teams. Groups are for viewing staff together; approvals are still done by admins regardless of group.
org.empty: No departments yet. Add the first one below.
org.duplicate_group: A group with that name already exists there.
org.group_in_use: A group that still has staff or teams cannot be hidden. Move them first.
org.parent_hidden: This team belongs to a hidden department. Restore the department first.
org.invalid_group: That department was not found. Please refresh.

manage.title: Manage
manage.selfNote: You cannot change your own role, reset your own sign-in or change your employment status here. Another admin does it. You can change your password yourself under "My account".
manage.reasonHint: Required (2+ characters). Who did it, when and why is kept in the change log.
manage.makeAdminHint: They can use staff management, approvals and records.
manage.removeAdminHint: They go back to a regular employee. Payroll access is removed too.
manage.grantPayrollHint: They can see the payroll screen and payroll files.
manage.revokePayrollHint: They can no longer see the payroll screen or payroll files.
manage.revokePhoneHint: When a phone is lost or the password may have leaked. The punch device is released too.
manage.revokePhoneNote: After this, every device is signed out right away and the current password stops working. Send the invite link again so the employee can create a new password. Until then, add punches with "Add record".
manage.resignHint: Sign-in is blocked right away. Records are not deleted.
manage.resignNote: Access is cut off immediately. Records and the account stay, and you can reinstate later if needed.
manage.reason_required: Enter a reason of at least 2 characters (up to 200).
manage.self_change: You cannot change your own account. Ask another admin.
manage.already: It is already in that state. Please refresh.
manage.employee_inactive: An inactive employee cannot be given a role.
manage.min_admins: This would leave fewer than 2 admins. Make another employee an admin first.
manage.min_payroll: This would leave no one with payroll access. Give another admin payroll access first.
manage.payroll_only_grant: Only someone with payroll access can give or remove it.
manage.payroll_needs_admin: Only an admin can have payroll access.
manage.pendingWait: It takes effect when another admin confirms.
manage.pendingHide: A role change request is waiting for confirmation. You can change it again after it is handled.
manage.request_pending: A role change for this employee is already waiting for confirmation.
manage.self_decision: You cannot confirm a change you requested. Another admin must confirm it.
manage.forbidden: Only the admin who requested it can cancel.
manage.revokeDeviceHint: When they changed or lost their phone. The password stays the same.
manage.revokeDeviceNote: After this, that device can no longer punch. The employee signs in on the new phone and registers it. Until then, add punches with "Add record".
manage.owner_only: Only the owner can change the owner account's role, status or sign-in.
manage.readOnly: This screen shows what is currently fixed in the app. Tell us if anything should be changed.

shiftKinds.title: Shift types
shiftKinds.intro: Types attached to shifts. They are chosen in shift templates and dated shifts.

note.normal: Ordinary work with clock-in and clock-out.
note.deemed: Counts the scheduled hours regardless of clock records.
note.outside: A day worked outside the office.
note.remote: A day worked from home or elsewhere.
note.holiday: Work on a holiday, counted as holiday work.
note.extra: Keeps the usual shift and only extends the end time.

leaveGroups.title: Leave groups
leaveGroups.intro: Groups of leave types. The group is set when a leave type is created or edited.

accrualRule.title: Leave accrual rule
accrualRule.intro: How annual leave accrues. A reference value is calculated from the hire date; a manager confirms and enters the grant.
accrualRule.r1n: One day accrues for each full month.
accrualRule.r2n: Granted anew on each hire anniversary.
accrualRule.r3n: From the third year, one more day every two years.
accrualRule.caution: Attendance under 80%, perfect attendance and fiscal-year settlement are not checked automatically, so the value is a reference and the manager's entry is what counts.

approvalRules.title: Approval rules
approvalRules.intro: Who approves each type of request.

effect.punch: The clock-in or clock-out record is created.
effect.overtime: Overtime, night and holiday work are recognised.
effect.shift: A shift is created on that date.
effect.leave: The leave is booked and deducted from the balance.
effect.leaveDelete: The leave is cancelled and the balance restored.
effect.work: Clocking outside the office counts as normal work that day.

workInfo.title: Work terms
workInfo.intro: Working conditions such as workdays, weekly rest day and hours. One company-wide default is used for now.
workInfo.caution: Wages and per-employee work terms are not entered yet. They will be added with payroll calculation.

messageTemplates.title: Message templates
messageTemplates.intro: Reusable formats for messages sent often.
messageTemplates.empty: Message templates are not available yet. Notices are written each time in “Notices”.

messageRules.title: Message automation
messageRules.intro: Rules that send messages automatically on set dates.
messageRules.empty: Message automation is not available yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ruleNone: No work hours yet. Lateness and overtime cannot be judged until you add them.
settings.ruleAddHint: This does not edit the current rule. It adds a new rule that applies from the date you choose; earlier dates keep the results of the old rule.
settings.ruleNote: A rule already in effect cannot be hidden (past dates were judged by it).
settings.holidayNone: No holidays registered. Public holidays are counted as working days.
settings.holidayDateHint: Only dates on or after {date} (so past months do not change).
settings.holidayNote: Work on a holiday counts as holiday work. Add temporary public holidays here when they are announced.
settings.hereYes: This device ({ip}) is on the office internet.
settings.hereNo: This device ({ip}) is not a registered office address.
settings.hereUnknown: The internet address of this device could not be read.
settings.networkNone: No address registered. Until then every punch is marked "outside the office".
settings.networkAddHint: The most reliable way: open this screen on a device connected to the office WiFi and tap "Use this device".
settings.networkNote: If the office internet changes, add the new address. Keep the old one for a few days rather than turning it off right away.
settings.invalid_time: The start time must be earlier than the end time (HH:MM).
settings.invalid_break: Enter both break start and end or leave both empty, and keep them inside work hours.
settings.invalid_workdays: Choose at least one working day, and the weekly rest day must not be a working day.
settings.past_date: A past date cannot be used.
settings.duplicate_rule: A rule already starts on that date. Hide that rule first.
settings.rule_in_use: A rule already in effect cannot be hidden. Add a new rule to change it.
settings.duplicate_holiday: That date is already a holiday.
settings.invalid_cidr: Check the address. Example: 203.0.113.7 or 203.0.113.0/24 (very wide ranges are not accepted).
settings.gpsOn: GPS check is on. When someone punches away from the office internet, the phone also sends its location; inside the radius counts as the office.
settings.gpsOff: GPS check is off. Register an office location to turn it on.
settings.locationAddHint: Most accurate: open this screen inside the office and tap "Use my location". Indoors the error can be tens of metres, so a radius around 100 m is recommended.
settings.locationFailed: Could not get the location. Allow location access in the browser or enter the coordinates yourself.
settings.locationNote: Location is requested only when the office internet check fails. A location judged outside the office is not stored. Collecting staff location requires prior consent.
settings.invalid_location: Check the latitude, longitude and radius (30–1000 m).
settings.break2Start: Second break start (leave empty if none)
settings.roundValue: {n}-minute steps — clock-in rounds up, clock-out rounds down
settings.roundHint: Example: with 15-minute steps, a 07:29 clock-in counts as 07:30 and a 20:47 clock-out as 20:45. The recorded times themselves are kept.

pc.descGeneral: Manage the week basis and company holidays.
pc.descWork: Manage the company's default working hours and workdays. Per-employee hours are set with shift templates.
pc.descPunch: Manage where staff clock in, how payable time is rounded, and how the office is verified.
pc.descBreak: Manage breaks that are deducted from working time automatically.
pc.weekStartNote: The 40-hour week and overtime are counted from Monday to Sunday.
pc.deemedNote: On days whose shift type is “Deemed work”, the scheduled hours are used regardless of clock records.
pc.pcPunchNote: Staff clock in and out only on their one registered phone. On a PC they view records and send requests.
pc.breakNote: Only the part of the work that overlaps these windows is deducted. E.g. working 08:00–12:30 deducts 30 minutes.
pc.manualBreakNote: Staff do not clock breaks themselves.
pc.desc_notify: What the app notifies about. Phone push notifications are not available yet.
pc.desc_access: Rules for who can see and handle what.
pc.desc_branch: How branches (departments and teams) are organised.
pc.desc_staff: Employee accounts and how staff join.
pc.desc_leave: How leave is counted and requested.
pc.desc_request: Request types staff can send and how they are approved.
pc.desc_message: Posting messages from managers to staff.
pc.desc_closing: Locking records so they can no longer be changed.
pc.desc_pay: What this app covers for payroll.
pc.desc_security: Rules for sign-in and record protection.
pc.fixedNote: These items show how the app works today. Tell us if any of them should be changed.
pc.desc_esign: Exchanging employment contracts and similar documents by e-signature.
pc.desc_advanced: Other options about how screens are arranged.

notice.label: Notice alerts
notice.note: A new notice pops up when the app is opened and the bell shows the unread count.

request.label: Request alerts (managers)
request.note: The number of pending requests is shown in red next to “Requests” in the menu.

push.label: Shift start · late alerts (phone)
push.note: Phone push notifications are not available yet.

admin.label: Manager
admin.note: Sees and handles every employee's schedule, attendance, leave and requests. A manager's own requests are handled by another manager.

payroll.label: Payroll officer
payroll.note: Only managers marked as payroll officers can open the payroll screen.

employee.label: Employee
employee.note: Sees only their own schedule, attendance, leave and requests.

change.label: Role change confirmation
change.note: Granting or removing manager rights takes effect only after another manager confirms.

places.label: Clock-in places per branch
places.note: Each branch is linked to clock-in places. Clocking in within a linked place's radius counts as the office.

number.label: Employee numbers
number.note: Each employee can have an employee number.

invite.label: Invitations
invite.note: A manager sends an invite code and the employee creates their own password.

device.label: Clock-in device
device.note: Staff can clock in and out only on their one registered phone. A manager releases the registration to change devices.

hourly.label: Hourly leave
hourly.note: Leave can be taken in hours, such as half days. One day counts as 8 hours.

pending.label: Pending leave
pending.note: Leave awaiting approval is shown separately and not deducted from the balance.

accrual.label: Automatic accrual
accrual.note: A reference value is calculated from the hire date; a manager confirms and enters the grant.

punch.label: Clock-in · clock-out requests
punch.note: Clocking outside a place's radius becomes a request and is recorded only when approved.

correction.label: Attendance corrections
correction.note: Requests to add a missing record or fix a wrong time.

overtime.label: Overtime confirmation
overtime.note: Managers confirm overtime, night and holiday work.

shift.label: Shift requests
shift.note: Requests to add a shift on a date. Approval creates the shift.

leave.label: Leave requests
leave.note: Staff choose a leave type and dates.

leaveDelete.label: Leave cancellation requests
leaveDelete.note: Requests to cancel approved leave. Approval restores the balance.

work.label: Off-site · trip · remote
work.note: When approved, clocking outside the office counts as normal work that day.

approver.label: Approver
approver.note: One manager's approval completes a request. A manager's own request is handled by another manager.

custom.label: Custom request types
custom.note: There are no company-defined request types.

notice.label: Messages (notices)
notice.note: Managers choose recipients, post a message and see who has confirmed it.

translate.label: Translation drafts
translate.note: A draft translation is made for English readers, and changed numbers or dates must be confirmed.

auto.label: Message automation
auto.note: There are no scheduled automatic messages.

day.label: Daily confirmation
day.note: Managers confirm attendance records day by day.

month.label: Period closing
month.note: Closing a period per employee to block requests is not available yet.

monthly.label: Monthly summary
monthly.note: Hours, overtime, night, holiday work, lateness and absence per employee by month, with Excel download.

week52.label: 52-hour week
week52.note: Weeks over the thresholds are flagged on the home and record screens.

snapshot.label: Report snapshots
snapshot.note: Saving a report at a point in time is not available.

scope.label: Payroll scope
scope.note: Totals used for pay (payable time, overtime, night, holiday) can be downloaded.

viewer.label: Payroll screen
viewer.note: Only managers marked as payroll officers can open it.

tax.label: Tax · insurance calculation
tax.note: Taxes and insurance are not calculated in this app.

login.label: Sign-in
login.note: Staff sign in with their own password and clock in only on the registered device.

audit.label: Change log
audit.note: Records who changed settings, employee data and records, and when.

consent.label: Privacy · location consent
consent.note: A consent screen is shown on first use; location is collected only after consent.

ip.label: IP access control
ip.note: Office network addresses are used only to verify clock-ins, not to block access.

use.label: E-contracts
use.note: This app does not exchange documents by e-signature.

homeCards.label: Mobile > home cards
homeCards.note: Staff can turn home cards such as this week's work and work notes on or off on their phone.

bulk.label: Bulk approval
bulk.note: Requests are reviewed and approved one at a time.

brand.label: Company logo
brand.note: The company logo is shown in the top bar and on the sign-in screen.

places.title: Work locations
places.intro: Register plants, client sites and field sites by coordinates and radius. A punch inside the radius is verified for that location. Locations are turned off, never deleted.
places.empty: No locations yet. Add one with the + button.
places.name: Location name
places.pickHint: Tap the map to set the spot. If you are at the site, “Use my current position” is the most accurate.
places.locateFailed: Could not get your position. Allow location access in the browser or tap the map.
places.branchesNone: No branch uses this location. Unassigned locations apply only to staff of branches with no locations chosen.
places.turnOffNote: Punches here will no longer be verified. Past records stay as they are.
places.invalid_location: Check the position and the radius (30–1000 m).
places.invalid_place: Name must be 1–40 characters; address up to 200.

branches.title: Branches
branches.intro: Register plants and departments as branches and attach work locations to each. Branches are hidden, never deleted.
branches.empty: No branches yet. Add one with the + button.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.placesHint: Choose where staff of this branch may punch. If none is chosen, all active locations apply.
branches.placesEmpty: No work locations yet. Add them in “Work locations” first.
branches.placesAll: No locations chosen. All active work locations apply for now.
branches.hideNote: A branch with staff or sub-branches cannot be hidden.
branches.duplicate_group: A branch with this name already exists.
branches.group_in_use: This branch still has staff or sub-branches. Move them first.
branches.parent_hidden: The parent branch is hidden. Restore it first.
branches.invalid_group: This branch cannot be used as a parent.

shifts.title: Shift templates
shifts.intro: Create templates for different start and end times and apply them to staff. Lateness, missing punches and today’s schedule on the home screen follow each person’s template. Grace period, break and workdays still come from the company work rule. Templates are turned off, never deleted.
shifts.empty: No templates yet. Add one with the + button.
shifts.baseRule: {n} staff without a template use the company rule {start} - {end}.
shifts.noRule: There is no company work rule yet. Set it first so templates can apply.
shifts.name: Template name
shifts.deemedNote: Deemed work: staff on this template are counted as having worked these hours on every workday even without punching. Days with punches are calculated from the punches.
shifts.assignOff: A template that is turned off cannot be applied. Turn it back on first.
shifts.assignSaved: Applied. Judgements use this template from today.
shifts.invalid_time: End time must be later than start time. Shifts past midnight are not supported yet.
shifts.duplicate_template: A template with this name already exists.
shifts.template_in_use: Staff are still on this template. Move them to another template first.
shifts.template_off: This template is turned off. Turn it on before applying.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.intro: Pick a day to see who works from when to when. A shift entered for that date (holiday work, overtime block, a one-day change) comes first, then the usual template, then the company work rule. Lateness and missing punches follow this schedule.
schedule.empty: No schedule on this day (a day off, or no staff).
schedule.noRule: There is no company work rule yet. Set it in company settings first.
schedule.extraNote: Overtime block: the usual schedule for that day stays, and only its end time is extended to the end of this block.
schedule.invalid_time: End time must be later than start time. Shifts past midnight are not supported yet.
schedule.hint: The time next to each date is the planned total for the people shown (start to end, breaks included). Up to 31 days at a time. ✕ cancels only schedules added for a specific date.
schedule.pcIntro: See everyone's shifts on a calendar and add or change shifts by date.

leaveTypes.title: Leave types
leaveTypes.intro: These are the leave types staff choose when requesting. Types can be hourly (e.g. morning half day 4 h 08:00–12:00, 1 h outing). Days deducted from annual leave = hours ÷ 8. When a leave with set times is approved, that time is not counted as late or early leave.
leaveTypes.name: Name
leaveTypes.builtinNote: The name and hours of default types cannot be changed. Create a new type if you need different hours.
leaveTypes.freeTimeNote: Without set times, staff enter a start time when requesting (optional).
leaveTypes.fullDayNote: Full-day leave does not need set times.
leaveTypes.turnOffHint: Turning off only removes it from new requests. Existing leave stays.
leaveTypes.turnOnHint: Staff can choose it again once on.
leaveTypes.invalid_time: End time must be later than start time.
leaveTypes.duplicate_type: A type with the same name already exists.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.intro: Labels that group staff by pay type or rank (e.g. 1. Hourly, 2. Salaried, 3. Manager: team lead). Each person has one, and the color bar in the schedule list uses this color. Not used in pay calculation yet.
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Add one with the + button.
jobs.name: Job name
jobs.assignOff: Staff cannot be added to a job that is off.
jobs.duplicate_job: A job with the same name already exists.
jobs.job_in_use: Some staff have this job. Move them to another job first.

missing.title: Missing punches
missing.intro: Days in the period where a punch in or out is missing. A missing punch in is flagged {m} min after the scheduled start, a missing punch out {h} h after the scheduled end. Full-day leave, approved off-site work and deemed work are excluded.

empty.in: No missing punch in for this period.
empty.out: No missing punch out for this period.

missing.noRule: There is no company work rule yet, so missing punches cannot be judged.
missing.hint: Tap a row to open that person’s records, where you can add the missing punch. Up to 62 days at a time.

recordList.title: Attendance
recordList.noRule: There is no company work rule yet, so records cannot be calculated.
recordList.hint: The time beside each date is the total working time (breaks excluded) of the staff shown. Tap a row to correct or add records for that person. Up to 62 days at a time.
recordList.addHint: Choose an employee to enter the date, time and reason. For your own record, send a correction request.

recordDetail.title: Attendance record
recordDetail.hint: Work and break times are for the whole day. Records are changed only through corrections.
recordDetail.cannotConfirm: A clock-in or clock-out is missing, so this cannot be confirmed yet. Fill it in under Edit first.
recordDetail.hintConfirmed: This record is confirmed. It is used for payroll, and corrections are blocked. Undo the confirmation to change it.

scheduleDetail.title: Schedule
scheduleDetail.hint: This is the regular schedule. Changing the template or company rule changes other days too.
scheduleDetail.hintShift: This schedule was added for this date only. Cancel it with ✕ in the schedule list.
scheduleDetail.onlyThisDay: This is the regular schedule. Saving here adds a different schedule for this date only; the regular schedule stays the same.

leaveDetail.title: Leave
leaveDetail.hint: Approve or reject in the inbox; cancel an approval under Approved leave.

confirm.releaseAsk: If you undo it, this day is left out of payroll and corrections are allowed again. Undo?
confirm.no_record: There is no record on this day.
confirm.not_closed: A record with a missing clock-in or clock-out cannot be confirmed. Fill it with a correction first.
confirm.pending_exists: There is a pending correction request. Handle it first.
confirm.self_decision: Your own record must be confirmed by another admin.
confirm.no_rule: Cannot confirm without a company work rule.

leaveAccrual.title: Leave accrual
leaveAccrual.pending: {n} day(s) pending approval are not counted as used.
leaveAccrual.noGrant: No accrual applies on this date. Add one below.
leaveAccrual.addHint: Saving with the same period name updates that entry. A future start date shows as Planned.
leaveAccrual.hint: Accrued days are entered by an admin. Automatic accrual and accrual by leave group are not available yet.

recordCalendar.title: Attendance
recordCalendar.empty: No employees to show this month.
recordCalendar.hint: Top line is clock-in, bottom line is clock-out. Totals show days with records and payable time. Click a cell to open that day.
recordCalendar.pcIntro: See each employee's clock-in and clock-out times for the month. The colour band under a cell is the job colour.

records.title: My records
records.olderHint: You can see the last {n} months. For older records, ask your manager.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.intro: Ask your manager to fix a record. The original record is kept; an approved correction is used for your hours.
corrections.nextDay: The time is after midnight (next day)
corrections.reasonHint: Work details only. Please do not write health or personal matters.
corrections.sent: Request sent. Your manager will review it.
corrections.reason_required: Please write a reason (up to 200 characters).
corrections.future_time: You cannot request a time in the future.
corrections.duplicate_request: You already have a waiting request for this record.

install.title: Add to your home screen
install.why: Then you can open the app with one tap, like any other app.
install.ios1: In Safari, tap the Share button at the bottom
install.ios2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
install.ios3: Tap "Add". Open the app from the new icon from now on.
install.android1: In Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu at the top right
install.android2: Tap "Add to Home screen" or "Install app"
install.android3: Tap "Add". Open the app from the new icon from now on.
install.other1: Open this page on your phone and add it to the home screen from the browser menu.
install.shareBelow: Close this guide and look at the bottom of the screen
install.iosFindA: 1. Tap the Share button (square with arrow) at the bottom of Safari
install.iosFindB: Not there? Tap ⋯ at the bottom right, then "Share"
install.iosThen: 2. Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen", then "Add"

passkeyHelp.inAppTitle: Open this page in your phone's browser
passkeyHelp.inAppIos: This page is open inside an app (KakaoTalk, etc.). Tap ⋯ or the share button and choose "Open in Safari".
passkeyHelp.inAppAndroid: This page is open inside an app (KakaoTalk, etc.). Tap ⋮ and choose "Open in another browser" → Chrome.
passkeyHelp.inAppFirst: Open this link in Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android), not inside KakaoTalk or another app.
passkeyHelp.ios2: Settings → your name → iCloud → Passwords (Keychain): turn it on.
passkeyHelp.ios3: Settings → Face ID & Passcode: a passcode must be set.
passkeyHelp.android2: Chrome must be signed in to a Google account (Settings → Google Password Manager).
passkeyHelp.android3: Settings → Security: a screen lock (PIN, pattern or fingerprint) must be set.
passkeyHelp.other1: Use a phone with a screen lock, and open the link in Safari or Chrome.

notices.title: Notices
notices.stale: This translation is out of date. Please check the Korean original.

leave.title: Leave & off-site
leave.pendingHint: Days waiting for approval come off your balance once approved.
leave.noGrant: Your annual leave for this year has not been entered yet. It will show here once your manager adds it.
leave.workdaysOnly: Only workdays count — weekends and public holidays are skipped.
leave.reasonHint: You can leave this empty. Only managers see it.
leave.sent: Requested {n} days. Your manager will check it.
leave.range_too_long: You can request up to 31 days at once.
leave.too_old: For dates more than 31 days ago, ask your manager directly.
leave.no_rule: Work hours are not set yet, so leave cannot be requested.
leave.no_workdays: There are no workdays in that range. Half and quarter days must be a single workday.
leave.duplicate_request: You already have leave on that date.
leave.no_grant: Your annual leave has not been entered yet. Ask your manager.
leave.insufficient_balance: This is more than your remaining leave (not counting requests waiting).
leave.startTimeHint: If entered, {h} h from that time is recorded as leave.
leave.not_approved: You can request deletion only for approved leave.

work.title: Off-site / trip / remote
work.intro: Tell us about days you worked outside the office. You can send it afterwards (within 31 days).
work.sent: Sent. Your manager will check it.
work.outsideHint: This clock-in was outside the office. If you were working off-site, send a request.
work.invalid_time: Hours only work for a one-day request, and the start must be before the end.
work.range_too_long: You can request up to 31 days at once.
work.too_old: For dates more than 31 days ago, ask your manager directly.
work.duplicate_request: You already have an off-site request waiting or approved for that time.

consent.title: Consent to collect and use personal data
consent.intro: To record attendance we collect and use the information below. Please read it and agree. You need to agree to use the app.

basic.name: Employee details
basic.detail: Name, employee number, department and job title, mobile number (if the company entered it)

punch.name: Attendance records
punch.detail: Clock-in and clock-out times, work notes, and your correction, leave and off-site requests

network.name: Internet address (IP)
network.detail: Recorded when you punch, to check whether you are on the office internet.

device.name: Punch device and sign-in information
device.detail: The type of the device you register for punching and a public key for it, and your sign-in password (stored encrypted; the company and managers cannot see it). Biometrics such as fingerprint or face stay on your device; the company never receives them.

location.name: Location
location.detail: If the company turns on the office-location check, your location is checked only at the moment you punch away from the office internet. Only a location confirmed inside the office radius is stored; any other location is not stored. You are not tracked at other times.

consent.purpose: Recording and managing working hours, the basis for pay calculation, and keeping records required by law
consent.keep: Kept for 3 years after your employment ends, then deleted.
consent.refuse: You may refuse. If you do, you cannot record attendance in this app and must use another method set by the company. Ask an admin if you have questions.
consent.consent_outdated: The notice has changed. Please read the new notice and tap again.

account.title: My account
account.createNote: You do not have a password yet. Create one and you can also sign in from a PC or another phone with your employee number and password.
account.hint: At least 8 characters. Changing it signs you out on all other devices.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.noRule: There is no company work rule yet, so the schedule cannot be shown.
schedule.hint: Planned time is the length from start to end, breaks included. If your schedule looks wrong, tell your manager.

requests.title: Requests
requests.emptyDone: No requests were handled in the last {days} days.
requests.doneHint: Only requests from the last {days} days are shown.
requests.punchFar: {m} m from the nearest work place
requests.emptyMine: You have made no requests in the last {days} days.

scheduleRequest.title: Schedule request
scheduleRequest.intro: Request a schedule that differs from your usual one, such as holiday work or extra hours. It becomes your schedule for that date once an admin approves it.
scheduleRequest.invalid_time: The end time must be later than the start time.
scheduleRequest.past_date: You cannot request a past date.
scheduleRequest.duplicate_request: A request for the same date and time is already pending.

desk.noRule: No company work rule yet, so the schedule cannot be shown.
desk.hint: You cannot clock in or out on a PC. Use your registered phone to clock in and out; here you can view schedules and records and send requests.
